newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer-export growth should not be overrated.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer-export growth should not be overrated.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer said on Monday that Germany's current export success should not be overrated as an indicator of the strength of Germany's economy.
Speaking at a banking conference, Tietmeyer said domestic investment is more important than the export outlook.
The Federal Statistics Office reported earlier this month that Germany's trade balance climbed to 7.2 billion marks in December from 6.4 billion marks in the same month a year earlier.
